walls.notes: 2 St Mary's Passage (Cambridge Satchel Co.). Geograph 4994976 square-on: grey-buff Cambridge gault brick, black classical shopfront with three round-arched lights (east part) and a pair of arched glazed doors at the west end, gold lettering; 2 upper sashes with white moulded architraves, one per wall segment. Second-floor windows assumed to repeat the first (Sahara photo shows a tall gault front above). x measured with the 6.8 m total frontage (p0 = east end).

West half of the Satchel Co. front (geograph 4994976): last arched shop light, glazed double door at x~2.4, black pilaster at the boundary with The Senate (1 St Mary's Passage); one white-framed sash above. Lower LiDAR height here (8.2 m) so only one upper floor modelled.
